title: The Hebrews' Understanding of God
description: From their earliest understanding of God to their latest.
items: YHWH is a local, tribal god; El is the chief god
YHWH is the biggest and baddest of the local gods
YWHW = El, king of all the gods
YHWH Elohim is the only god; all the others are nothing or demons
YHWH Elihim is God, the metaphysical ground of all being, that which is beyond anything that can be thought
